spec_text: An on-field entity population functions as a CONSUMABLE RESOURCE POOL spent by the kit. Seven attested sub-shapes: loot-drop-stream as summon ammunition (animate-weapon); planted lingering entities as a detonation queue (bladefall+bladeblast); proxy max-life as per-cast ammo, proxy-pattern inversion (dark-pact); corpses as detonation substrate WITH damage scaling off the victim's max life, a severable scaling-model wrinkle (detonate-dead, the family's one GAPPED member); random-nearby-minion sacrifice snapshotted into spell damage (minion-pact-bv); proxy-consumes-proxy sustain (reaper); flask-spawned HOSTILE fodder as guaranteed proc-target ammunition (wormblaster, conf 0.72-0.82 caveat, promotion-gate-fail kit). Engine has no lane where entities are a spendable substrate rather than actors. Dominant gap family of the PoE1 basin.
notes: Per-batch self-counts drifted (mappers cannot see sibling batches); this row is the definitive membership. Matt-tier ruling at REVIEW BOOK: mint an entity-pool substrate lane, or declare the family permanently approximated.

mechanism_class: ally-buff-projection scope-boundary (party-support in a solo-only engine)
spec_text: Aurabot's entire purpose is reserving the full pool to project 10-16 auras onto ALLIES (Generosity shares to allies, NOT self), multiplying PARTY output with zero personal damage — explicitly 'useless solo' (source mech_note). The engine is solo-scope; there is no ally to receive the projected buff, so the kit's reason-for-existing has no lane. This is NOT a missing mechanism minted by adding a mechanic — it is a fundamental scope boundary (solo vs party). Distinct from aurastacker (self-recipient, IS solo-viable). SECONDARY tension shared with aurastacker: source reserves ~100% of pool, exceeding the engine reservation_percent 0.75 LOCKED cap (clamped in-map). Destination is the docket as a scope-boundary record: either (a) Aurabot is permanently out-of-scope (party-support has no solo home), or (b) a future co-op/party layer would re-home it. No author mint is appropriate against a scope boundary.
notes: Not a mint request — records the locked solo-only design boundary as the reason this archetype cannot land. Permanent-scope evidence.

mechanism_class: RNG-element-pool identity (per-hit/per-entity random element from a fixed pool)
spec_text: Each attack/entity rolls ONE random element from a fixed pool. elemental-hit: per-attack roll with meta pool-PRUNING to force mono (the build deletes its own randomness). skeleton-mages: per-entity roll, pruned/converted by gear. wild-strike: per-hit random element AND random secondary geometry with NO pruning endpoint (negative-canon exemplar). Engine element identity is fixed per kit; no random-from-pool lane.
notes: wild-strike is negative=1 trap-canon: any future lane design must preserve the pruning-endpoint distinction (prunable = build; unprunable = trap).

spec_text: Heavy Strike Stun's identity is TWO-fold and both halves lack an engine lane: (1) DAMAGE SCALES OFF THE STUN MODEL -- the build stacks ~75% reduced-enemy-stun-threshold and its damage is computed from stun magnitude/buildup; the engine's `stun` ailment (ailments.yaml: physical+lightning hard-control) is a CROWD-CONTROL primitive, NOT a damage source, and there is no T4 strategy for 'convert stun buildup into damage'. (2) RELENTLESS STUN-LOCK -- the build's feel is chain-stunning everything; but the engine stun ailment carries a DELIBERATE anti-stunlock floor (immunity_after_seconds, min 1.0s HARD guard 'prevent perma-stun via rapid re-apply') and boss stun-resistance, so the engine STRUCTURALLY refuses the perma-stun the build is built around. Mapped as melee_strike + stun ailment + the nearest T4 (MOMENTUM_CASCADE, a build-up-to-payoff reading), grade APPROX -- captures 'a heavy melee that stuns' but loses BOTH the stun-as-damage model and the stunlock feel. Would require either (a) a 'control-magnitude-as-damage-source' strategy (stun/freeze buildup converts to a damage payoff) -- a genuinely new capstone class, evidence-gated; or (b) a ruling that stun stays CC-flavor and the damage rides normal scaling, accepting the identity loss. NOTE: low source confidence compounds this (post-cutoff 3.28 kit; delivery/econ conf 0.3-0.4, econ 'unknown') -- the gap should be re-checked if a deeper dossier lands. Ladder audit: map (stun ailment + melee exist) -> approx (stun becomes CC-flavor not damage; MOMENTUM_CASCADE nearest door, noted, grade APPROX) -> quantitative mint? NO -> qualitative mint-candidate (control-as-damage-source) filed to docket for steward ruling.
notes: GAPPED member; engine deliberately prevents perma-stunlock — collision with an intentional design guard, not an oversight.

mechanism_class: self-damage cast-cost redirected to a proxy's life pool
spec_text: Forbidden Rite's identity is that the spell COSTS THE CASTER LIFE (enough to kill them) but, when cast THROUGH totems, the life-cost is PAID BY THE TOTEM ENTITIES instead of the player -- the totems bleed so the caster stays safe (Soul Mantle + Hierophant totem chassis). The engine can model an hp-cost on a skill (resource_economy.hp_cost_scale, LOCKED <=0.30) and can model totem-proxy delivery (PROXY_ASCENSION), but it has NO primitive to REDIRECT a skill's self-damage-cost onto a proxy entity's life pool. Mapped as totem-proxy delivery + a capped hp-cost on the chassis (grade APPROX), which loses the cost-laundering that IS the build's safety identity. Would require either (a) a 'cost-payer = proxy-entity' resource-redirection primitive (proxy pays the hp/life price a skill would otherwise charge the caster), or (b) an explicit ruling that the outsourcing is flavor-only and 'hp-cost on the chassis + totem delivery' is the canonical approximation. Ladder audit: map (hp_cost lane exists) -> approx (cost lands on caster not totem, noted, grade APPROX) -> quantitative mint? NO (not a range/count extension of an existing param) -> qualitative mint-candidate? this is a NEW mechanism (cost-payer redirection) so it is evidence-gated; filed to docket for steward ruling on whether it is minted or declared flavor-approximation.
notes: Cost-REDIRECTION shape. Cross-ref closed-loop row: adjacent self-damage economies, mechanically distinct.

mechanism_class: closed-loop self-damage trigger economy (autonomous perpetual cast engine)
spec_text: Ward Loop's identity: Summon Skeletons (To Dust: ~0.2s lifespan) -> minions die instantly -> Heartbound Loop rings convert each minion death into flat SELF-damage (2x420 phys) -> that self-damage exceeds the CWDT threshold -> CWDT re-casts Summon Skeletons + payload spells -> loop closes, sustained by Olroth's Resolve Ward absorb. A perpetual motion cast engine that runs at full throughput in an EMPTY ROOM. Engine has the reactive hop natively (on-damage-taken -> linked-cast, depth 1, + RETRIBUTION_ENGINE) but THREE closures are missing: (a) no minion-death -> self-damage lane (no self-hit primitive; b04 forbidden-rite steward precedent — hp_cost_scale is a COST, it does not generate trigger-feeding damage-taken events); (b) MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 LOCKED forbids the cyclic re-entry (the trigger's consequence regenerates its own condition — depth is unbounded); (c) Ward flat-absorb-refresh window economy only approximated. Mapped remainder = reactive CWDT chassis (grade GAPPED; player test: original needs no enemies, map does). Ladder audit: map (one trigger hop OK) -> approx (reactive-only inverts the identity) -> quantitative mint NO (depth mint is template-forbidden) -> qualitative (self-damage-generation + cyclic trigger closure = new mechanism class) -> docket. Destination: either (i) a self-damage-event primitive (kit-internal damage-taken generation) + a steward ruling on bounded loop closure, or (ii) a ruling that closed-loop autocast is out of engine scope and reactive-CWDT is the canonical approximation for the whole loop family.
notes: Loop TOPOLOGY gap: kit-generated damage-taken re-enters its own trigger condition. MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 locked against cyclic re-entry — collision with an intentional guard. Cross-ref forbidden-rite row.

spec_text: Minions raised as copies of WORLD/MAP monsters: the summoner's minion pool is the game's enemy roster, and each raised minion INHERITS the captured monster's native ability kit (dossier: 'Raise permanent copy of map monster; spectre fights independently' + 'Spectres retain all their monster abilities'). Engine proxies are kit-generated content with kit-declared skills; there is no capture-from-world acquisition lane and no monster-ability-inheritance lane. Companion questions if minted: corpse-fuel acquisition ritual (Desecrate) and per-era pool identity (Solar Guards / Slave Drivers / Syndicate Operatives) as selectable minion loadouts.
notes: Ruling fork preserved: mint a capture-class proxy mechanism, or declare spectre-class permanently proxy-approximated (which would re-grade the kit APPROX under a future ruling).

spec_text: Iron Commander Siege Ballista's identity: '+1 to maximum number of Summoned Totems per 200 Dexterity' — gear/attribute stacking literally COUNTS the turret army (econ_raw=stat-counts-army); every itemization decision is visible as army growth. Engine: totem proxies are native (geometry totem), attribute-stacking gear affixes are native (trait lane), but proxy COUNT is generation-fixed — no lane binds a stat VALUE to entity count. Ladder audit: map (totem battery OK) -> approximate+note (fixed count; DEX regresses to ordinary stat scaling; grade APPROX, deviation mandatory) -> quantitative mint? NO — not a widen of an existing param (no stat->count parameter exists to extend, and merely raising max totem count would NOT land the identity) -> qualitative mint-candidate (a NEW coupling mechanism: attribute-value drives proxy-count), evidence-gated, filed as docket for steward ruling: (a) mint an attribute->proxy-count coupling primitive, or (b) rule stat-counting flavor-only with fixed-count-battery + attribute-traits as the canonical approximation. Single-kit evidence so far; other stat-counts-a-thing kits (D2 '+skill per charge' lineages, PoE stacked-attribute uniques) may accrue — steward should sweep before minting.
notes: Scaling-SUBSTRATE gap (stat determines count); distinct from the totem-hierophant COUNT mint (quantitative range extension).
